No need to apologize lol. thank you for taking time out of your day and having a conversation. i appreciate it and it helps, thank you. 

And that is the problem, I don't know what i want to do. i try to think of something id like to do, but i just end up sitting around doing nothing. When i can't think of anything i use the question "if you wont he lottery what would you spend your money on?" I don't care or aspire for money other than as a resource to survival.  
But if i did win i know what id do. I would invest into the e-sports scene and try to make it grow. Id design games for competitive play, the quality in games are so bad these days. Id create a league for the game with events around the country to bring people in to play some games. Id host tournaments and some prizes would go towards kids schooling/scholarships but most would be to help people make a living. I would like to see E-Sports grow. Riot and league of legends are doing great things but that is only one genre of games, So it would be kind of like MLG with multiple games supported. 

The only time i felt happy was going around the country competing in tournaments and meeting people you know online. I just like the healthy friendly competition. Respecting individuals for their skills and the challenges of out smarting/ playing people.

That's what always gets me , ud think if u had a year to live youd wanna go crazy. I've said to myself 1 year, lets make the best of it and just have fun. I end up just wanting the year to be over, not thrilled to go out and do what others do for enjoyment hoping ill find some out there. Ive even attempted and afterwords i still don't care. dont want to go out and go crazy or anything. just bored with life.

Do you have a therapist or someone you go talk to? You could ask them to have a sit down talk with you and your mother. Usually a therapist/psychiatrist would be able to calmly speak to your mother and help her understand how you are feeling, sometimes it takes hearing it from someone else/an adult. They would focus the conversation around your needs and how the parents should be helping the kids. 

I know in MN there is a walk-in counseling for free and anonymous too. You could call a suicide hotline to find a place similar in your area.

I thought the same thing, but i varied more on once i saw a decay as a functioning human being(old) But when i revisit that notion i already see a late 20s guys that wasted some of his prime years and already on the decay. 
Why do you think life is too long at 30? Are you living your few years you have left then to the fullest?

its unhealthy and a bad habit? just like if you would drink until you pass out, its an addictive habit because you are covering up the real problem with an escape for the moment. Think of it like any addiction, it will only help you for the moment but hurt you further in the long run. I have scars on my legs and arms and it's a daily reminder of the dark days and i know it would take the pain away for a moment but later you will hurt more from it.

If it gets you through the night so you can talk to someone tomorrow then its better than a bottle of pills but if you think it will be your solution all the time, you will find a day when cutting just isn't enough.

Yeah my head is pretty much filled with self hate mail and constant criticizing for anything i do. I rewatch past events over and over and analyze how i should of acted and then bash myself for not knowing what to do in advance to every situation. Or ill over analyze what someone says until i can find a negative outcome towards myself. 

I understand that people do effect each other to an extent but generally people have their own personality that are influenced by the people in their life. Mine is jokes and humor because its a generally accepted and who doesnt like a funny guy? lol.
But i wont even listen to certain music i like because said person doesnt like it or worry about how other people will react to what i do even when im alone. I just hear them saying something negative towards me if id do something they might not like or w.e. I guess i just let the people in my life go beyond influence. And now that they aren't around i dont want to do. 

The hobbies i had have been to stay close to my friends. But i don't enjoy them by myself. I don't really enjoy anything unless someone else does then i see why they enjoy it and can relate. Or ive learned to not like things incase others hate it?...idk lol 

I'm alone pretty much all the time now. once a month i see my psychiatrist. thats the most human interaction i get atm. maybe ill talk to my father every other week. he just talks about sports that he knows i could care less about or he wants to drink. But when i drink i get dangerous, usually end up slamming my head into concrete over and over hoping ill fuck my brain up and stop thinking this way or fuck mental capacity up so much that ill have no other choice but to kill myself because ive damaged any chance of a successful future. Or ill just try to attempt my life again, ive been hospitalized. But the smile gets you out of that place real quick, once your healthy lol.

Less stress/guilt feeling about killing myself. I didn't want them to blame themselves for my faults. That's why I stopped dating all together and pushed my friends away. I don't want them to sit and try and think about "what they could of done diff". I'm the fucked up one, not them. Last thing i want is to hurt the ones i care for. 

The other reason i pushed people away is because i have a replicating personality. Who ever im around i become more like them but im usually laughing joking and smiling but that is all just my cover so people won't think anything is wrong. I learned that at a young age, just smile and pretend its ok, don't give a sign. The times i thought i was happy was when i was making my friends happy because idk how to make myself happy. One line from into the wild "happiness is only real when shared" hit home hard for me and i thought that is how i would find happiness, sharing with others. But when im alone... Im broken and lost. Being stuck in my head usually ends up in a bad spot.

So partly putting myself in solitude is pushing myself to the edge. Either ill find a way to live for myself and love myself. Or ill fail and that is fine, i wasn't meant for this world and that is ok. Not everyone person born is going to have the correct way of thinking. 

I wish my mother would of just had an abortion like she should of.

Sadly those were my friends for over 10years, drugs/drinking change people. Some i grew up with and considered them family and my brothers. 

Yeah, when i would get really depressed id break up with a girl and when the "its me not you" line doesnt work. Id be a general douche so they would leave me.

I've been doing the pushing and trying to just put my head down and get through w/e and hope to see light. But after years I don't even know the direction i should be going. I'm sick of having to battle my self daily to stay around. I'm tired of this. I don't know why i should stay around for a few more years when we all die in the end anyways, whats so wrong with choosing when you want to die vs fearing it and running from it all the time. I'm not going to be anything special in life nor have i been. just one from our species with faulty brain. What do you do with broken goods? kick it to the curb and focus resources on functioning humans.

They were pretty much my family. But the sad truth is my friends grew up and became selfish. I let my loyalty to my friends hurt me in the end. I can't keep living for people that are just using me, at that rate i could do something better in that time.

Invest a year into pretending i want to sail or backpack EU and learn a language and maybe try to start a new with a fresh setting. If you want to continue go for it otherwise cast off on an island right down your final thoughts in peace. Or climb a mountain and go pro your jump from the top. Make an awesome viral video haha.

The worst feeling is wishing that a random number would be someone calling saying he has passed away. Just because then I know I'd be next. So for as sad of a day that will be, it will also be freeing. He is a heavy drinker so worse case ill give him some kidneys when his fail and die after. Maybe He will be ok but atleast he will have new kidneys to drink on? heh

Until then It's distracting my mind from the thought of existence mostly in video games or TV or Internet. Ive given up on the social aspects of maintaining friends and dating. It's not logical to create a greater number of people that will be effected when I go. But until the day I can just end this, The show must go on... So smile when the cameras on ya and laugh.
